evidence.custodyNote: This build adds fund custody + executeSwap, which reverts a real spot trade when the realized fill breaches the slippage floor (proven in test/MandateExecution.t.sol). Exercising that refusal on-chain needs test USDC, an allowlisted Kuru router call, and a deployed IPriceSource adapter — wired in the next phase.

appMandate.note: Mandate whose agent is the Charter app's passkey account. The mobile app simulates the agent proposing a trade (gas-free eth_call); a 3.00x long reverts LeverageExceeded (shown as 'Refused by your mandate'), a 1.50x long is allowed. See app/lib/mandate.ts.
